content:
We need to add CO2 to silicon slab at specified adsorption site with height ~2.0 Å. We have paths to slab CIF, CO2 CIF, and chosen_site.json. Need to read site JSON to get site info (maybe fractional coordinates). Then use add_adsorbate_to_slab_text tool with slab_cif string, adsorbate_cif string, height default 2.0, site optional.

First, read the slab CIF and CO2 CIF and site JSON. Use read_file.
